clue.text: What Alan Rickman initially performed outside, being dauntless

clue.text: Severus Snape, initially concealing concern, is frightening

parts.note: care means concern or worry

clue.text: Juliet's heart's extremely lovely, a thing of great purity

clue.text: Bill and Ted originally supported by university friend in fact

explanation.definitionFit: A saunter is a leisurely stroll, and one in the park is a typical example, hence 'perhaps'.

clue.text: Bending over and coupling

pairing up, as when two people share a room

clue.text: Irrationally taking slices out of Emma's dolly

clue.text: Complaint from highly-qualified female
